title: Parallel sum
blurb: Step 14 of the learning path. One workgroup of 64 invocations adds up an array. Each invocation adds every 64th number, then the workgroup halves its partial sums in rounds through `workgroup` memory. `workgroupBarrier()` makes every invocation wait, so a round reads only what the round before wrote. The CPU tier refuses a barrier, so this step lists WebGPU and WebGL2, which runs the barrier in its pass program.

tierNotes.cpu: The CPU tier refuses an entry that reaches a barrier (Rule 8.24).
